description: Pause a Company Search or Company Enrich task and return its updated status. Free: it charges and refunds nothing. A queued task pauses at once; a running one finishes its current batch first (status pausing, then paused). Pausing loses no data: the companies delivered so far stay readable with company-search-status, and the task keeps its progress. Billing does not change: the reservation made when the task started stays reserved while paused and is settled only when the task ends. Undo it with company-search-resume, which continues from where the task stopped with no new charge. Limit: a task paused for more than 7 days is cancelled by the API and can no longer be resumed; you then pay only for the companies already delivered, the rest of the reservation is returned, and the companies delivered stay readable for 30 days.

task_id.description: task_id returned by company-search or company-enrich, example: '5b33f3ee-168b-4780-9c8e-63a626781872'. A People Search task_id is not found here.
